verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a keyboard-driven editor: the `[[` shortcut links text and `cmd j` opens the AI palette on highlighted text. Users describe Reflect as fast and easy to use, and one notes that uploaded files and images live in notes, implying some embedded media. Nothing documents the specific formatting elements the story asks for. Missing for 10: documented headings, callouts, tables and code blocks; explicit embedded-media documentation; a keyboard-shortcut or slash-command reference for formatting; hands-on corroboration of the formatting depth.
